general.title: General
general.description: Configure instance-wide defaults that affect how operator-visible logs are displayed.

deployment.localTrusted: Local trusted mode is optimized for a local operator. Browser requests run as local board context and no sign-in is required.
deployment.authenticatedPublic: Authenticated public mode requires sign-in for board access and is intended for public URLs.
deployment.authenticatedPrivate: Authenticated private mode requires sign-in and is intended for LAN, VPN, or other private-network deployments.

censorUsername.title: Censor username in logs
censorUsername.description: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.

keyboardShortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keyboardShortcuts.description: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating issues or toggling panels. This is off by default.

backupRetention.title: Backup retention
backupRetention.description: Configure how long to keep automatic database backups at each tier. Daily backups are kept in full, then thinned to one per week and one per month. Backups are compressed with gzip.

feedback.title: AI feedback sharing
feedback.description: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
feedback.noDefault: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.

notAllowed.label: Don't allow
notAllowed.description: Keep voted AI outputs local only.

signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.description: Sign out of this Paperclip instance. You will be redirected to the login page.

access.adminRequired: Instance admin access is required to manage users.
access.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to manage company members.
access.title: Instance Access
access.description: Search users, manage instance-admin status, and control which companies they can access.
access.selectUser: Select a user to inspect instance access.

companyAccess.title: Company access
companyAccess.description: Toggle company membership for this user. New access defaults to an active operator membership.

experimental.title: Experimental
experimental.description: Opt into features that are still being evaluated before they become default behavior.

isolatedWorkspaces.title: Enable Isolated Workspaces
isolatedWorkspaces.description: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing issue runs.

autoRestart.title: Auto-Restart Dev Server When Idle
autoRestart.description: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.
